payload.name: Preserve_Explicit_Advice_During_Extraction
payload.description: When extracting memory candidates, preserve explicit advice, recommendations, or instructions in content instead of summarizing a mixed message as generic support; use when a speaker gives concrete guidance alongside encouragement.
content: During candidate extraction, if a source message contains explicit advice, recommendations, or action steps, include that specific guidance in the candidate content; do not reduce the message to a generic emotional-support summary.
When a message mixes concrete instructions with encouragement, prioritize the actionable content so a future recall can retrieve what was advised, not just that support was offered.
When updating an existing memory, ensure the new content preserves or merges any concrete advice from the source and does not become more generic than the previous version.

solves: Diagnosed cause: an extraction candidate reduced a message containing concrete advice to a generic summary of encouragement, so future questions about the advice cannot be answered. The reusable mechanism is collapsing actionable guidance into vague support during memory extraction. This applies to any conversational message where a speaker gives explicit recommendations alongside emotional support; the skill ensures those recommendations are preserved in memory content.
